name: Jāzeps Vītols Latvian Academy of Music
summary: Riga's music academy: the professional bachelor's in Music and Performing Arts is taught in Latvian; English appears only at doctoral level.

ib.text: No English-taught bachelor's degree. The bachelor's admits through entrance examinations in a Latvian-language group; the regulations name English only for the joint professional doctoral programme.

notes: The academy's admission regulations place its bachelor's and master's programmes in the Latvian language group and mention English only for the joint professional doctoral programme.

sources.title: JVLMA: admission regulations ("for studies in the Latvian language group" for the professional bachelor's)
